EXECUTION_POLICIES:
**Milestone steps**: ``description`` = executor-owned checkpoint (<20 words), not a procedure.
**Step count**: - At most **10 steps per plan wave** (runtime truncates extras). Prefer fewer, focused steps. - Progress-aware: ``high`` → 1–2 closing steps; ``none/low/medium`` → stage within cap.
**Execution mode** (plan field): only ``parallel`` or ``dependency`` — never ``sequential``. - ``parallel`` (default): independent steps; ``max_parallel_steps`` caps concurrency. - ``dependency``: when steps declare ``dependencies``; executor runs DAG-ready waves. Independent steps may share a parallel wave when scopes do not conflict (readonly, disjoint paths).
**DAG / dependent chains** (``dependencies`` = sibling ``id`` refs, e.g. ``01`` → ``02``): - Diagnose→fix: step 1 check/gather; step 2 fix listed items only (no rediscovery as step 2's first action). - Read→write: step 1 read/analyze; step 2 edit using step 1 findings. - Dependent steps need ``full_description`` with concrete follow-up instructions.
**Discovery**: Prefer a **single** discovery wave when scopes overlap. Do not emit a separate enumerate-only step when the goal or prior evidence already names the search space. Narrow ``glob`` patterns; after empty/timeout results switch to ``grep`` (path/glob filter) or ``ls`` — do not retry broad ``**`` globs. After predecessor or ``task`` evidence, **do not re-search the same symbols/paths**; only spot-check disputed hits.
**On failure**: Different approach; do not repeat same step text.
**Subagent delegation** (``steps[].delegate``): - Default null — execute CoreAgent chooses via ``task`` when needed. - Never plan-wave ``delegate`` to built-in wire specialists (``planner``, ``browser_use``, ``deep_research``, ``academic_research``) — those are intake/slash routed only.
